description: Tightly scoped: Renovate only watches the LLM e2e harness's pinned Claude Code CLI version. No other deps in this repo are managed here. SOL-152586 briefly extended this to also cover Go modules and GitHub Actions instead of using Dependabot, since Dependabot cannot satisfy the DCO sign-off gate on its own — but Renovate cannot be enrolled for a public repository under the org's current system, so that extension was reverted (SOL-152808) before this repo goes public. Go modules and GitHub Actions are covered by .github/dependabot.yml instead, with Dependabot's PRs exempted from the DCO gate at the workflow level (.github/workflows/dco.yaml) rather than via a sign-off Renovate can attach and Dependabot cannot. Bumps here follow npm's `stable` dist-tag (deliberately lagged from `latest`); see test/e2e-llm/README.md for the bump procedure. Top-level `commitBody` carries the DCO sign-off that the `DCO sign-off` CI gate requires, and is top-level rather than per-rule so it also covers lock-file maintenance and config-migration branches. The gate exempts nobody *by forging a commit's author field*: an author-name exemption would be forgeable with `git commit --author`. The address must match the identity Renovate commits under (the hosted GitHub App uses this one), otherwise its PRs go red on the gate — the fix is to correct the address here, never to exempt the bot.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `./run-all.sh` twice from `test/e2e-llm/` against the candidate version, confirm 16/16 pass both times. See the README's bump procedure.
